How to use a skinfold caliper
  1. Stand relaxed. Take the readings on your right side and ask someone to help if a site is hard to reach.
  2. Pinch the skin and fat away from the muscle. Place the caliper jaws across the fold about 1 cm below your fingers and keep holding the fold.
  3. Read the caliper in millimeters after about 1–2 seconds. Rotate through the three sites and repeat. Average two close readings at each site.
